# VU Research Portal

> > Research portal for Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam showcasing academic activities, publications, conferences, and institutional collaborations across disciplines including law, philosophy, psychology, and natural sciences.

The VU Research Portal documents the scholarly work and institutional engagements of Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam researchers. It includes conference presentations, academic lectures, committee memberships, and external organizational affiliations spanning fields from EU law and reformed philosophy to social cognition and photon dynamics.

## Key Topics

- Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
- Academic lectures and conference presentations
- EU Law and Transnational Legal Studies
- Reformed philosophy and Philosophia Reformata
- Social cognition research
- NWO (Dutch Research Council)
- External organisation memberships
- Committee and advisory board participation
- Kooijmans Institute
- Boundaries of Law
- Democratic Europe initiatives
- Peer review activities
- Interdisciplinary research collaboration

## Research Presentations & Conferences

- [Paranoia versus trust: evidence for a reduced cooperation in psychosis](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/paranoia-versus-trust-evidence-for-a-reduced-cooperation-in-psych): Poster on psychosis, paranoia & trust at neuroscience conference
- [Diversity and team outcomes: The moderating effects of outcome interdependence and group longevity](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/diversity-and-team-outcomes-the-moderating-effects-of-outcome-int): Academy of Management presentation on team diversity & outcomes
- [The relationship of self-esteem, self-efficacy, external locus of control with the Big Five](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/the-relationship-of-self-esteem-self-efficacy-external-locus-of-c): European Conference on Personality study on Big Five traits
- [Contribution to Carbon Cycle and Climate Stability via Expansion of Azonal Boreal Forests](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/contribution-to-carbon-cycle-and-climate-stability-via-expansion-): Conference presentation on boreal forests in Ukrainian Carpathians
- [Explaining the financial performance of very small service firms](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/explaining-the-financial-performance-of-very-small-service-firms): ICSB World Conference presentation on small service firm performance
- [Modelling of colliding sub-picosecond pulses in a semiconductor optical amplifier](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/modelling-of-colliding-sub-picosecond-pulses-in-a-semiconductor-o): Symposium on semiconductor optical amplifier pulse collision modelling

## Academic Lectures & Symposia

- [ASI Symposium: The role of science in times of polarisation](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/asi-symposium-the-role-of-science-in-times-of-polarisation): ASI symposium on science's role during societal polarisation
- [Desistance and restorative justice](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/desistance-and-restorative-justice): Academic lecture on desistance and restorative justice in criminal law
- [The self-in-talk: Towards an analysis of interpersonal language and its use](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/the-self-in-talk-towards-an-analysis-of-interpersonal-language-an): Lecture on interpersonal language analysis in social psychology
- [Velocity Imaging of Photon-Induced Dynamics: from State-to-State to Femtosecond Studies](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/velocity-imaging-of-photon-induced-dynamics-from-state-to-state-t): Seminar on velocity imaging techniques for photon dynamics research
- [Congres Nederlands Afrikaanstalig Wijsgerig Genootschap](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/congres-nederlands-afrikaanstalig-wijsgerig-genootschap): Philosophy congress lecture on globalization and university
- [Naar een professionele vereniging van professionele ingenieurs](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/naar-een-professionele-vereniging-van-professionele-ingenieurs): NIRIA lecture on professional engineering associations in Netherlands

## External Organisations & Memberships

- [NWO, Laan van Nieuw Oost Indie 131, Den Haag](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/nwo-laan-van-nieuw-oost-indie-131-den-haag-external-organisation): NWO external organisation profile with committee membership details
- [Philosophia Reformata (Journal)](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/philosophia-reformata-journal-37): Academic journal profile for Philosophia Reformata with advisory board
- [Vereniging Democratisch Europa, Amsterdam](https://research.vu.nl/en/activities/vereniging-democratisch-europa-amsterdam-external-organisation-2): Vereniging Democratisch Europa external organisation membership page
